CloudBackupSnapshot.title: CloudBackupSnapshot
CloudBackupSnapshot.description: User-scoped encrypted/serialized cloud sync snapshot of all RupeeStory modules and preferences.

userId.description: The authenticated Firebase UID of the owner.

deviceName.description: Name or model of the Android device that uploaded the backup.

summaryText.description: Human-readable summary of counts (transactions, accounts, notes, tasks, habits, etc.).

transactionCount.description: Number of transactions in this snapshot.

totalItemsCount.description: Total number of records across all modules in this snapshot.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the cloud backup document was first created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the cloud backup document was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}/cloud_backups/{backupId}.description: Per-user cloud sync snapshots isolated strictly to the authenticated owner.
